name: one-to-one-calendar
description: A 1:1 from the calendar: the invite's other person is the one voice.
lines: Hi, thanks for making the time, how was the conference?
Really good actually, lots of interest in the new pricing, I'll write it up for you.
Great. Did you get a chance to look at the hiring plan?
Yes, I think we need one more designer before the launch, otherwise we'll slip.
Okay, let's put that in the plan and I'll take it to finance.
